7	
8	/// A saved journal entry — plain `{id, content, source, chatMessageId,
9	/// occurredAt, serverRevision, createdAt, updatedAt, mediaDurationSeconds}`
10	/// class, no `freezed` (mirrors `AuthenticatedUser`: this feature has no
11	/// need for the union/copyWith machinery `Failure` uses). Boundaries:
12	/// never a field beyond this exact set — `tags`/`piiStatus`/`piiSpans`/
13	/// `embeddingStatus` still belong to later epics, not this story.
14	/// [mediaDurationSeconds] was the one field Story 3.1 deferred (its own
15	/// comment named it "later epics") — spec-3-2 is that story, for the
16	/// `source: audio` entries it produces.
17	///
18	/// [occurredAt]/[createdAt]/[updatedAt] are kept as the backend's own ISO
19	/// 8601 strings rather than parsed into `DateTime` — nothing in this story
20	/// reads or formats them (Design Notes: the Hive box nothing reads from
21	/// yet), so parsing would add risk (a malformed string throwing) with no
22	/// behavior to justify it.
23	class Entry {
24	  const Entry({
25	    required this.id,
26	    required this.content,
27	    required this.source,
28	    required this.chatMessageId,
29	    required this.occurredAt,
30	    required this.serverRevision,
31	    required this.createdAt,
32	    required this.updatedAt,
33	    this.mediaDurationSeconds,
34	  });
35	
36	  final String id;
37	  final String content;
38	  final EntrySource source;
39	
40	  /// Non-null only for a [EntrySource.chat]-sourced entry (RF10) — always
41	  /// `null` for this story's [EntrySource.manual] entries.
42	  final String? chatMessageId;
43	  final String occurredAt;
44	  final int serverRevision;
45	  final String createdAt;
46	  final String updatedAt;
47	
48	  /// Non-null only for an [EntrySource.audio]-sourced entry
49	  /// (`AudioEntryCubit.save()`) — `null` for every other source.
50	  final int? mediaDurationSeconds;
51	
52	  @override
53	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
54	      identical(this, other) ||
55	      (other is Entry &&
56	          other.id == id &&
57	          other.content == content &&
58	          other.source == source &&
59	          other.chatMessageId == chatMessageId &&
60	          other.occurredAt == occurredAt &&
61	          other.serverRevision == serverRevision &&
62	          other.createdAt == createdAt &&
63	          other.updatedAt == updatedAt &&
64	          other.mediaDurationSeconds == mediaDurationSeconds);
65	
66	  @override
67	  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
68	    id,
69	    content,
70	    source,
71	    chatMessageId,
72	    occurredAt,
73	    serverRevision,
74	    createdAt,
75	    updatedAt,
76	    mediaDurationSeconds,
77	  );
78	
79	  @override
80	  String toString() =>
81	      'Entry(id: $id, content: $content, source: $source, '
82	      'chatMessageId: $chatMessageId, occurredAt: $occurredAt, '
83	      'serverRevision: $serverRevision, createdAt: $createdAt, '
84	      'updatedAt: $updatedAt, '
85	      'mediaDurationSeconds: $mediaDurationSeconds)';
86	}

172	3. Kanban column in "Planos de Ação" — color by column **[ext]**.
173	
174	### Micro-animations and transitions
175	- `scrimIn` (0.18 s ease-out): fade of the darkened background when any overlay opens.
176	- `sheetUp` (0.2 s ease-out): bottom sheets (insertion modal, filter, export) rise from the bottom of the screen.
177	- Continuous spinner (`spin`, 1 s linear infinite) in every loading state.
178	- Text streaming: the AI response is revealed progressively, with a blinking cursor at the end while it is "typing".
179	- PIN: after the 4th digit, a 350 ms pause before navigating.
180	
181	---
182	
183	## 4. Special states that need extra care
184	
185	- **Expired session:** an overlay on the chat that keeps history and scroll position — the expired token must not discard the conversation state in memory before re-authentication. Re-authenticating goes back to the Biometria screen, not to a full form.
186	- **Offline:** blocks **sending new messages** (send icon disabled, explanatory banner), but **history stays visible and navigable**. The prototype does not show what happens to the insertion modal (text/audio/photo) when offline.
187	- **Asynchronous processing — audio transcription:** a loading state (spinner + frozen waveform) and two outcomes (success/error); the error always offers "Tentar novamente" and never loses the recorded audio.
188	- **Asynchronous processing — photo OCR:** same pattern as audio, with one extra exit on error: "Salvar só a foto", which saves the record even without extracted text.
189	- **Asynchronous processing — export:** two loading stages (preparing → generating the AI summary) before the result; on error, the raw data is always available for download — the failure is isolated to the AI narrative, never to the user's data.
190	- **Dashboard narrative unavailable:** the chart loads normally but the AI summary paragraph fails — distinct from "zero entries" (lack of data) and needs its own error message.
191	
192	---
193	
194	## 5. Implementation notes
195	
196	1. **"29 frames" vs. "32 states":** the prototype has 32 distinct navigable states, but the number of frames (29) suggests that some state families should be one screen with internal state, not separate routes (e.g., a single `ExportSheet` with a status enum instead of 5 routes). Consider this when designing navigation.
197	2. **Account deletion without a success screen:** both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to the Biometria screen; there is no "account deleted" or "you signed out" screen.
198	3. **Login vs. sign-up:** the same screen toggled by a text link; the prototype shows no extra sign-up fields (e.g., password confirmation, name). Whether sign-up needs extra fields is a product decision not covered visually.
199	4. **Insertion modal when offline:** not represented.
200	5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.
201	6. **Per-entry sync indicator:** the states "sincronizado / sincronizando / erro de sync" exist visually on the cards, but no explicit "retry sync" action is shown for the error state. The semantics of the badge are in `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`.
202	7. **Text search combined with filters:** the filter sheet and the text search are on the same screen, but the prototype does not show them acting together.
203

- New `entities/entry_date_group.dart` — `EntryDateGroup{date, entries}` + pure `groupEntriesByDate()` (no flutter import, RNF06), grouping by `occurredAt.toLocal()` truncated to day, preserving input order.
- `repositories/entries_repository.dart` — added `list({cursor, limit = 20})`.

**Data** (`lib/features/entries/data/`):
- `datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart` — added `list()` via `ApiClient.get('entries-list', ...)`, mirroring `create()`'s try/catch parse-failure mapping.
- `repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart` — implemented `list()`: persists each page to the `entries` Hive box before returning `Right`; on `networkOffline`/`networkTimeout` falls back to a full Hive dump sorted `occurredAt` desc with `nextCursor: null`; every other `Failure` propagates unmapped.

**Presentation** (new):
- `lib/core/widgets/skeleton_box.dart` — generic shimmering placeholder, built only from `colorBorder`/`radiusSm`.
- `entries/presentation/widgets/entry_record_card.dart` — mirrors `_KanbanCard`'s spine structure; spine/icon by `EntrySource` using the prototype's exact `sourceMeta` hex-to-token mapping (manual→colorPrimary, audio→colorSecondary, photo→colorTextSecondary, chat→colorAccent), reusing Material icons already used elsewhere in the app for the same origins. Not tappable, no badge.
- `entries/presentation/widgets/entry_skeleton_card.dart` — skeleton variant, dimensions built only from existing spacing tokens.
- `entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_{state,cubit}.dart` — new sealed state (`Loading/Empty/Error/Loaded`, never `Resource<T>`); `loadFirstPage()`/`loadMore()`/`retryLoadMore()`.
- `entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` — `BackArrowHeader` + 300ms skeleton-delay (mirrors `BootSplashScreen`'s `Timer` pattern) + scroll-pagination + grouped list with day labels ("Hoje"/"Ontem"/date).

**Wiring:**
- `entries_injection.dart` — registers `MeusRegistrosCubit` as `lazySingleton` with `dispose: close()`.
- `app_router.dart` — `/meus-registros` now builds `MeusRegistrosScreen(cubit: sl())`.
- `placeholder_screens.dart` — deleted `MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen`.

**One real bug found and fixed during testing:** the scroll listener's `loadMore()` had no guard against a failed page's footer (spinner→"Tentar novamente" button) subtly shifting `maxScrollExtent`, which re-fired the scroll listener and retried forever — an actual infinite-retry risk in the live app, not just a test artifact (it surfaced as a `pumpAndSettle timed out` failure). Fixed by splitting `loadMore()` (scroll-triggered, now a no-op once `loadMoreFailed` is already true) from a new `retryLoadMore()` (the footer button's explicit, one-time-allowed retry past that guard).

Updated existing tests that needed to accommodate the new `EntriesRepository.list()` method and the real screen replacing the placeholder: `app_router_test.dart`, `placeholder_screens_test.dart`, `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`, `back_arrow_header_test.dart`, and the three `insertion_modal*_test.dart` fakes (added trivial `list()` overrides).

## New tests
- `test/features/entries/domain/entities/entry_date_group_test.dart` — empty list, midnight-boundary grouping (written offset-free to stay timezone-independent across machines), order preservation, never-createdAt.
- `entries_remote_data_source_test.dart` — `list()`: query params, decoding, empty page, malformed body, offline/timeout/authExpired pass-through.
- `entries_repository_impl_test.dart` — `list()` success/Hive-write-failure, offline/timeout fallback (sorted, empty box, other-failure-skips-fallback).
- `meus_registros_cubit_test.dart` — first load (loaded/empty/error), pagination (append/dedup/cursor/failure-keeps-items/the-new-loadMoreFailed-guard/retry).
- `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` — skeleton timing (below/above 300ms, fast-resolve-never-flashes), zero/error states with retry, grouped rendering, scroll-triggered pagination (success + failure, including the regression test for the infinite-loop bug).

## Verification
- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — all 606 tests pass.
- `dart format` applied to every file I touched.

## Left incomplete / risks
- Acceptance Criteria's third bullet ("session expiry overlay appears, scroll position preserved, nothing throws") is satisfied structurally — `ExpiryOverlayHost` shows its dialog via `showGeneralDialog` on a route *above* this screen, and the cubit is a DI singleton provided via `BlocProvider.value` (never closed by the widget) — but I did not write a dedicated end-to-end test putting `MeusRegistrosScreen` specifically under that overlay (the mechanism is already generically proven in `main_test.dart` against `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen`). Low risk, but noted since it's not independently verified for this screen.
- Day-group ordering and the "Hoje"/"Ontem" label depend on the device's local clock at render time — correct per spec, just calling out as expected, non-deterministic-by-design behavior.
- No manual airplane-mode check was run (no device/simulator exists per AGENTS.md) — the offline path is covered only by the automated Hive-fallback tests.
